description: This file contains utility functions for object detection, including image preprocessing, bounding box correction, non-max suppression, YOLO output decoding, and evaluation metrics. It references external libraries such as OpenCV, NumPy, SciPy, and custom bounding box classes, indicating it is part of an object detection project using YOLO models.

methods.name: _sigmoid
methods.description: Applies the sigmoid function to input x using scipy.special.expit.

methods.name: makedirs
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path, handling exceptions if the directory already exists.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a detection model on a dataset, computing mean Average Precision (mAP) scores for each class.

methods.name: correct_yolo_boxes
methods.description: Adjusts bounding box coordinates to match the original image size after resizing.

methods.name: do_nms
methods.description: Performs non-max suppression on bounding boxes to eliminate duplicates based on IoU threshold.

methods.name: decode_netout
methods.description: Decodes the raw output of the YOLO network into bounding box objects.

methods.name: preprocess_input
methods.description: Resizes and normalizes an input image for YOLO model input.

methods.name: get_yolo_boxes
methods.description: Predicts bounding boxes for a batch of images using the YOLO model.

methods.name: compute_overlap
methods.description: Calculates the intersection-over-union (IoU) between two sets of bounding boxes.

methods.name: compute_ap
methods.description: Calculates the average precision from recall and precision curves.

methods.name: _softmax
methods.description: Computes the softmax of input array x along specified axis.
